settings.title: A legacy built on trust
settings.text: Our family's entrepreneurial journey began when Shri Manikji Birla founded Abhay Travels, laying the foundation of a legacy rooted in trust, integrity, and service.

settings.title: A turn toward saffron
settings.text: Carrying that legacy forward, Shri Abhayji Birla and Aditya Birla ventured into the world of saffron with a passion for authenticity and quality.

settings.title: MAA KESAR takes root
settings.text: Through MAA KESAR, we began cultivating and processing premium saffron in Srinagar. That deep-rooted connection with one of nature's most treasured ingredients would later shape MY CRANBI.

settings.title: MY CRANBI is born
settings.text: Inspired by that journey, my mother-in-law and I founded MY CRANBI with a simple belief that premium personal care should be honest, effective, and thoughtfully crafted.

settings.heading: A family story rooted in saffron, trust, and thoughtful care.
settings.intro: At MY CRANBI, we believe that true beauty is nurtured through honesty, thoughtful innovation and the finest gifts of nature. Inspired by the richness of saffron and India's timeless botanical heritage, we create premium skincare and personal care products that blend nature with modern science to deliver care you can truly trust.
settings.quote_text: Guided by our philosophy, every formulation reflects our commitment to authenticity, research, and uncompromising quality. For us, premium personal care should always feel honest, effective, and beautifully considered.
settings.closing_text:
MY CRANBI is more than a brand; it is our family's promise to deliver purity, compassion, and conscious care in every product. As we continue to grow, our vision remains unchanged: to build a trusted Indian brand that brings together heritage, nature, science, and innovation to enrich everyday lives.

Thank you for placing your trust in MY CRANBI and becoming a part of our journey. We look forward to being a part of yours.
settings.signature: With gratitude, CA Unnati Birla, Co-Founder, MY CRANBI

settings.title: Heritage of Velvet Touch
settings.text: Our formulations are guided by a family philosophy that blends the richness of saffron and India's botanical heritage with research-led care for modern routines.

settings.title: Rooted in real saffron
settings.text: Through our family's MAA KESAR venture in Srinagar, pure Kashmir saffron remains central to the identity, authenticity, and sensorial richness of MY CRANBI.

settings.title: Free from, never compromised
settings.text: Every ritual is crafted without sulphates, parabens, silicones, or formaldehyde so the care feels as honest as it is indulgent, and proudly made in India.

settings.heading: Heritage, saffron, and honest formulation remain at the center of MY CRANBI.
